### 3.3 Documentation delivery

The equipment documentation deliveries are as specified in the Generic SOW [AD 028].

Formal submittals for equipment reviews:


<table border=1 style='margin: auto; word-wrap: break-word;'><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Review acronym</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Review name</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Unit</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>KO</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Kick-off</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>✗</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>EQSR</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Equipment Qualification Status Review</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>✗</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>IR</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Intermediate Review</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>✗</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>MRR</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Manufacturing Release review</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>✗</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>TRR</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Test Readiness Review</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>✗</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>TRB</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Test Review Board</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>✗</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>DRB</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Delivery Review Board</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>✗</td></tr></table>

## Formal Submittals for Boards (As Design, As Built):

Not applicable for HAA EM, but to be noted for HAA FM :


<table border=1 style='margin: auto; word-wrap: break-word;'><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Board acronym</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Boards name</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Unit</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>MPCB</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Material and Process Control Board</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>X (2)</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>PCB</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Parts (EEE) Control Board</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>X (2)</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>ERCB</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Equipment Radiation Control Board</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>X</td></tr></table>

Note (1): the above mentioned boards shall be held at the timeframes required in the Generic SOW [AD 028]. They shall take place prior to MRR, TRR and TRB and their findings reported to the chairperson of those reviews for proper conclusion.

Note (2): Only as-designed PCB and MPCB have to be held for HAA EM(Q)
